overview: Force Affliction is a adept-level dark side technique classified under Mind. Inflicts debilitating pain, nausea, or weakness directly through the Force, wearing down opponents without ever touching them. Nightsister magick and Sith torture techniques both drew upon affliction to break captives during the Clone Wars.
history:
Force scholars trace Force Affliction across eras recorded in holocrons, Jedi Archives data-tapes, and Sith tombs on Korriban and Dromund Kaas. Practitioners documented in Clone Wars · KOTOR II · The Old Republic · Rebels established the modern understanding of how this ability manifests in combat, meditation, and ritual.

During the Old Republic and Sith Empire conflicts, masters drilled Force Affliction into initiates as part of the standard curriculum for mind specialisation. Surviving battle logs from the Clone Wars and Galactic Civil War show the technique adapted to blaster-era warfare, starfighter engagements, and close-quarters lightsaber duels.

In the sequel era, surviving texts and oral traditions kept knowledge of Force Affliction alive even as the Jedi Temple fell and the Sith assumed new forms. Each generation reinterpreted the power through its own doctrine while the underlying Force mechanism — channelled midi-chlorian symbiosis and focused will — remained constant.

The dark side amplifies this power through passion, anger, and the will to dominate — at the cost of corruption and suffering.
significance:
Force Affliction exemplifies how mind abilities shape Force doctrine on the dark side. At adept mastery, users balance raw potential against discipline, emotional control, and the moral weight of their choices.

Historians note that armies and orders rose or fell partly on how widely and wisely this technique was taught. A single master of Force Affliction could turn a skirmish, break a siege, or unravel an enemy's will before blades crossed.

For students today — in academies, hidden enclaves, or alone with ancient texts — Force Affliction remains a benchmark of mind proficiency across the Star Wars saga.
